purpose: Fitbite homepage photo-based hero example bowl
prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent PNG photo cutout for a Fitbite homepage hero.
Input image 1 is the edit target.
Primary request: remove ONLY the pale wooden tabletop background and its exterior contact/cast shadow. Make every area outside the bowl truly transparent with an alpha channel.
Preserve the original photographed bowl exactly: cobalt blue textured glazed ceramic, original circular bowl shape seen at the original elevated three-quarter/top angle, the rim and visible front wall, original lighting, original proportions and camera perspective.
Preserve all existing food and its precise arrangement: white rice center; avocado fanned at upper left; cucumber at upper right; red onion on right; edamame lower right; red cherry tomatoes lower left; existing sesame, spring onion and crisp garnish. Do not add, remove, restyle, regenerate or rearrange any food.
Composition/framing: complete single bowl with every outside edge visible and a little transparent breathing room on all sides. Keep centered. No crop to the bowl, no cut edges.
Constraints: background removal only; high fidelity to input photograph; no text, no logo, no extra objects, no added ingredients, no artificial halo, no opaque/checkerboard background, no shadow painted outside the bowl silhouette. Actual transparent alpha is required. This hero is an example complete bowl, not a selection state.

validation.visual_inspection: Full blue ceramic bowl visible without cropped edges; original elevated camera angle and same ingredient groups/placement retained; wooden tabletop removed; no text, extra objects, added ingredients or visible exterior cast shadow.

limitations: Generative background extraction is visually faithful, not a guarantee of pixel-identical food or ceramic detail.
Built-in output is 1672×941, below the original 3840×2160 resolution.
Most bowl interior pixels have near-opaque alpha 253/255; faint low-alpha antialias pixels extend beyond the visible silhouette. No external alpha normalization or image editing was performed.
Raster photo cutout; this is not a 3D bowl model.
